verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Parse as layout-aware OCR that turns complex layouts into clean, LLM-ready markdown or JSON, which implies headings and structure are kept. A hands-on community report also praises its output on a complex-layout document. However, no evidence explicitly documents heading levels, section nesting or reading-order preservation, so the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit docs on heading/section hierarchy in the output, documented reading-order handling for multi-column layouts, independent benchmarks of structure fidelity.
